Notes.ContainsLine1: They checked in another patient a week ago, something related to psychotic episods.
Notes.ContainsLine2: Heard the last guy he was under had to take extended leave, something to do with an injury on the job.
Notes.ContainsLine3: Don't know what the issue is, he's been calm all this time.

Notes.ContainsLine1: A month has past since he's been here, he has had some outbursts, but nothing to the degree I was told.
Notes.ContainsLine2: He has mentioned some sort of creature that he sees, but the description seems to be more demonic then human.
Notes.ContainsLine3: If this keeps up, surgey might be required.

Notes.ContainsLine1: A nurse tried to give him medicine today and... I can hardly believe it.
Notes.ContainsLine2: His outbursts have gotten worse and worse, I heard he's gotten his hands on keys to the security room.
Notes.ContainsLine3: I hope this isn't the case, god only knows what he will do...
